examples.label: Base64-encode the PHP webshell for the payload

notes: Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2018-7600) covering Drupal 7 and 8 - the highest-value option when the version matches. The base64 step just smuggles the PHP shell past request parsing.

recommended.note: Turn the unauth RCE into an interactive reverse shell

name: Drupalgeddon2 - RCE (CVE-2018-7600)
description: Exploits CVE-2018-7600 (Drupal 7/8) for unauthenticated RCE, typically dropping a base64-decoded PHP webshell that is then invoked with a command parameter.

defense.why_it_works: Drupalgeddon2 (CVE-2018-7600) exploits the Drupal Form API. User-supplied '#' prefixed form properties are processed by AJAX callbacks without sanitization, injecting arbitrary PHP callbacks that execute system commands. No authentication required.
defense.prerequisites: Drupal 7.x < 7.58 or 8.x < 8.3.9/8.4.6/8.5.1. Unauthenticated -- the vulnerable endpoint is accessible without login.
defense.impact: Unauthenticated RCE as www-data. Webshell placement. Full server compromise from a single HTTP request.
defense.detection: POST request to /user/register or Drupal forms with '#' prefixed parameters. IDS signature for CVE-2018-7600 payload pattern.
defense.artifacts: Web server access log (POST to /user/register with exploit payload) | IDS alert for Drupalgeddon2 signature | New .php file created by web server process
defense.splunk_spl:
index=sysmon EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*w3wp.exe" OR ParentImage="*httpd*" OR ParentImage="*apache*" OR ParentImage="*php-cgi*" OR ParentImage="*php-fpm*" OR ParentImage="*java.exe" OR ParentImage="*tomcat*")
| where match(Image, "(?i)(cmd|powershell|bash|sh|nc|python)")
| table _time, Computer, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine

index=web sourcetype=access_combined (method=POST OR status=500)
| stats count by clientip, uri_path | where count>3
defense.elastic_kql: event.code:"1" AND process.parent.name:(w3wp.exe OR httpd OR apache2 OR php-fpm OR java.exe) AND process.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe OR bash OR sh OR nc OR python*)
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd","apache2","php-fpm","php-cgi","java.exe","nginx")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","bash","sh","nc","python")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc
// Drupalgeddon2 (CVE-2018-7600) unauth RCE - apache/php spawning a shell
defense.prevention: Update to Drupal 7.58 / 8.5.1 or later immediately. Enable automated security update notifications. Apply WAF rules with CVE-2018-7600 signatures.
defense.misconfiguration: Unpatched Drupal 7.x or 8.x accessible from the internet without WAF protection.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Drupal 7.x < 7.58 or 8.x < 8.5.1
# Vulnerable form element handling in form.inc
# '#post_render', '#type' callbacks not sanitized
defense.secure_config:
# Patch to current Drupal release
drush pm-update
# WAF rule: block '#' prefixed parameter names in POST bodies
defense.evasion: URL-encode payload to bypass simple WAF string matching. Use multipart form encoding.

validation.success_criteria: At least one behavioral detection fires within 60 seconds of attack execution
response_steps: Correlate alert with source host, user account, and timestamp
Review PowerShell Script Block / Module Logs, Sysmon, Windows Security Event Log, Web proxy logs for surrounding context (5 min before/after)
Verify whether the activity matches known administrative baselines or change windows
If confirmed malicious, isolate the host and escalate to incident response

explain:
Unauthenticated RCE on Drupal 7/8 via CVE-2018-7600:
  python3 drupalgeddon2.py   the exploit (typically drops a PHP webshell)
The flaw in Drupal's Form API renders attacker input as code; the exploit usually writes a base64-decoded '<?php system($_GET[...]);' shell you then invoke with a command parameter for RCE.
